definitions.meaning: món khai vị, món ăn trước bữa chính

examples: We ordered some appetizers while waiting for our main course.
The restaurant offers a wide selection of appetizers.

definitions.meaning: thực đơn, danh sách các món ăn

examples: Could we see the menu, please?
The menu changes every season to use fresh ingredients.

definitions.meaning: đặt bàn, đặt chỗ trước

examples: I'd like to make a reservation for two for Saturday evening.
They couldn't get a table because they hadn't made a reservation.

definitions.meaning: người phục vụ bàn (nam)

examples: The waiter brought us our drinks within a few minutes.
She asked the waiter to recommend a dish from the menu.

definitions.meaning: gọi món, đặt hàng
món đã gọi, đơn hàng

examples: Are you ready to order, or do you need a few more minutes?
Our order took almost forty minutes to arrive.

definitions.meaning: hóa đơn thanh toán

examples: Could we have the bill, please?
They split the bill equally between the four of them.

definitions.meaning: tiền boa, tiền thưởng cho nhân viên phục vụ
cho tiền boa

examples: It is customary to leave a tip of around 15 percent in American restaurants.
She tipped the waiter generously because the service was excellent.

definitions.meaning: món chính, món ăn chủ yếu trong bữa

examples: I chose grilled salmon as my main course.
The main course was served with vegetables and mashed potatoes.

definitions.meaning: món tráng miệng

examples: Would you like to see the dessert menu?
We shared a chocolate cake for dessert.

definitions.meaning: phần ăn, suất ăn

examples: The portions here are very generous — I couldn't finish mine.
Could I have a smaller portion of rice, please?

definitions.meaning: ẩm thực, phong cách nấu ăn đặc trưng của một vùng hoặc quốc gia

examples: This restaurant specialises in Italian cuisine.
She loves trying different cuisines when she travels abroad.

definitions.meaning: giới thiệu, đề xuất món ăn

examples: What do you recommend from the menu?
The chef recommended the grilled sea bass as today's special.

definitions.meaning: món đặc biệt trong ngày, món ưu đãi

examples: The waiter told us about the specials for the evening.
Today's specials include a fresh tuna steak and a mushroom risotto.

definitions.meaning: dị ứng (thực phẩm)

examples: Please let us know if you have any food allergies.
She has a nut allergy, so she checked the ingredients carefully.

definitions.meaning: thức ăn mang về, đồ ăn mang đi

examples: We didn't feel like cooking, so we ordered a takeaway.
The restaurant offers both dine-in and takeaway options.

definitions.meaning: ăn tối, dùng bữa (thường ở nhà hàng)

examples: We dined at a lovely Italian restaurant near the hotel.
They prefer to dine out on weekends rather than cook at home.

family_words.meaning: thực khách; nhà hàng bình dân kiểu Mỹ
việc ăn uống; thuộc về ăn uống

definitions.meaning: lần rót thêm, bổ sung thêm đồ uống
rót thêm, đổ thêm

examples: Can I get a refill on my coffee, please?
The waiter refilled our water glasses without us having to ask.

definitions.meaning: thuần chay (không dùng thịt)
người ăn chay (không ăn thịt)

examples: Do you have any vegetarian options on the menu?
She has been a vegetarian for over five years.

family_words.meaning: người ăn thuần chay (không dùng cả sản phẩm từ động vật)

definitions.meaning: miễn phí, được tặng kèm (không tính tiền)

examples: The hotel restaurant offers complimentary breakfast for all guests.
They brought us a complimentary plate of bread while we waited.

definitions.meaning: phục vụ, mang món ăn đến bàn

examples: Dinner is served between six and ten o'clock.
The waiter served each guest individually.

definitions.meaning: nấu quá chín, làm chín quá mức

examples: Be careful not to overcook the pasta — it should still have a little bite.
The steak was overcooked and tough, so we sent it back.

definitions.meaning: biên lai, hóa đơn xác nhận đã thanh toán

examples: Could I have a receipt, please?
Keep your receipt in case you need to claim expenses.

definitions.meaning: chỗ ngồi, khu vực chỗ ngồi

examples: The restaurant has both indoor and outdoor seating.
We were shown to our seating by the host.

family_words.meaning: chỗ ngồi; sắp xếp chỗ ngồi

definitions.meaning: hấp dẫn, kích thích cảm giác thèm ăn

examples: The food looked very appetising when it arrived at the table.
The smell coming from the kitchen was incredibly appetising.

family_words.meaning: cảm giác thèm ăn, khẩu vị

definitions.meaning: không chứa gluten, phù hợp cho người không dung nạp gluten

examples: Do you have any gluten-free options on the menu?
The bakery sells gluten-free bread and cakes.

family_words.meaning: gluten (chất đạm có trong lúa mì)
